label: calibration
design: Both conditions start from the same world (workshop-1, library sharing within a cohort, bounded search, teaching off). Every 60 ticks the whole cohort retires to storage and an identical fresh cohort replaces it. 'preserved' lets the library show admitted workflows of earlier cohorts; 'reset' hides them. Each researcher has the same proposal budget. Freezes select artifacts by validation evidence at each boundary and at the end; sealed scores are computed after the run closes.
selection_rule: lowest validation score among admitted or superseded workflows; ties by creation tick then id

freezes.rule: lowest validation score among admitted or superseded workflows (legacy: lowest evaluation energy); ties by creation tick then id; no sealed input
